description:
[Market] Skins listed for less than the resources they break down into. The list on rust.wiki/skins/below-breakdown: skins whose cheapest listing costs less than the Cloth, Wood or
Metal they give when broken down in game. Each row: the skin (`name`, `itemdefid`, `resource`, `qty` it breaks
into, `value` of that at the resource's Steam price), `target` (the value to beat for `basis`), the cheapest
qualifying listing (`best_market`, `best_price`, `best_qty`, `best_url`), `saving`/`saving_pct`, and up to three
`others`. Marketplaces whose data is stale right now are left out, as on the page. `resource_prices` /
`resource_net` give each resource's Steam price per unit.

basis.description: Value to beat: the resource's Steam listing price (`gross`), or what selling it on Steam actually leaves after the 15% fee (`net`).

resource.description: Only skins that break down into this resource.

sort.description: `pct` = biggest saving %; `abs` = biggest saving in cents; `price` = cheapest; `name`.

name: find_below_breakdown_skins
title: Skins listed for less than the resources they break down into
